name: test_inputs/test_inputs_url_filters_extensions
template:
<input name="in_1">
groups="in_1_group"
url = "./mock_data/dataset_1/"
filters = r"data_\d"
</input>

<input name="in_2" groups="in_2_group">
url = "./mock_data/dataset_2/"
extensions = ["log"]
</input>

<group name="in_1_group">
interface {{ interface }}
 description {{ description | ORPHRASE }}
 ip address {[ ip }} {{ mask }}    
</group>

<group name="in_2_group" input="in_2">
interface {{ interface }}
 description {{ description | ORPHRASE }}
 ip address {[ ip }} {{ mask }}    
</group>
